long_biography.plain_text:
Aviation has become one of businessman Dick DeVos's clearest public contributions. A certified jet and helicopter pilot, he founded West Michigan Aviation Academy as a tuition-free charter high school near Grand Rapids' airport. The school connects academic study with aviation and engineering, and DeVos continues as its board president.

Through Grand Action and its successor, Grand Action 2.0, DeVos has also spent decades on Grand Rapids civic development. The private-sector coalition helped advance an arena, convention centre, medical school and downtown market. His role brought business and community leaders together around projects that changed the city centre and established a continuing model for public-private development.
